data.title: Girokonto Klassik fee increase – consent required by 30 November 2026
data.summary: Musterbank eG wants to raise the monthly account fee for Sam Rivera's Girokonto Klassik from €4.90 to €6.90 starting 1 December 2026, and asks for explicit consent (Zustimmung) by 30 November 2026.
data.explanation: Your bank wants to raise the monthly fee for your Girokonto Klassik from €4.90 to €6.90 starting 1 December 2026. Following a German court ruling, banks need your explicit consent for such changes — your silence does not count as agreement. You can consent online in your banking portal or by returning the signed reply form, or you can decline. If you don't respond by 30 November 2026, the bank may end this account with two months' notice, though you can also cancel it yourself at any time free of charge. If you're a student or apprentice under 27, you could ask about the fee-free "Start" account model instead.
